Definition: Uri, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, of the tribe of Judah. Geber the son of Uri was Solomon's officer in Gilead.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God calls men by name for His work: Uri's son built the tabernacle with Spirit-filled hands, and another Uri's son governed Gilead, and both were named because both mattered.
